gaps.gap: Futon triage status distinctions (e.g. :partial vs :still-open vs :watch) collapse into Plane's five groups; :partial's 'shipped with named residue' is lost
No ticket states a priority, so every issue converts priority=none; Plane's order among open items reduces to state group then updated
External needs (world-state / external-item targets) have no Plane record; they are carried in external_needs and count as unmet
Edge evidence (file, line, verbatim quote, :edge/source :prose-reading) has no Plane field on IssueRelation; carried in extras
Dependencies inside one ticket (T-zai-chat H1->H5 ladder; T-fail-invoke-error triage) are expressible neither in edges.json nor in Plane records
A cancelled-group blocker does not count as met (:blocker-cancelled); Plane's blocked_by has no such semantics
